scope: R03/R04 paired scales and centroid averaging references
eligible_subfields: same >=256 as primary Subfield size control
centroid_null: shuffle paper assignments within period, preserving each group size and its period composition
centroid_normalization: average row-normalized paper vectors; L2-normalize centroids before CKA/RSA
paired_neighbors: same 50 fixed queries per Subfield, same 256 total candidates including queries; 206 sampled from Subfield or parent Field, without replacement; all ten models share selections
interpretation: Agreement is compared at each scale using the same kind of measure. A centroid score and neighbor fraction are not the same quantity. The paired candidate contrast changes topical scope while fixing query IDs, count and k.
